$Comment: Old Jack's board: one contract a night, drawn at midnight UTC from every contract naming this board, the pack's own and any a companion mod adds. The Requires block makes the board absent while the event is off, and its contracts pay the moment the work is done, so nothing waits on a board that has gone for the year. Order 90 keeps it behind a server's everyday boards. Where keeps it in the Forgotten Temple: anywhere else it is left out of every list and opens closed, so its contracts are handed in there.
